apps.description: Your age encryption key, from maki's recovery phrase. Anyone can encrypt files to it with age; decrypting one asks you on maki first. Open it for your recipient as a QR code.
apps.name: Age

permissions.name: ask
permissions.reason: To ask you on maki's screen before each file it decrypts.

permissions.name: link
permissions.reason: So age on your computer can ask maki to decrypt a file for you.

permissions.name: keys
permissions.reason: For your age key: maki's, from your recovery phrase, the same on a restored maki.

apps.description: Your Bitcoin wallet, from maki's recovery phrase: native SegWit and taproot accounts, and a key for multisig wallets, for Sparrow, Bitcoin Core and maki desktop, by cable or QR codes alone; every payment, the change and the fee shown on maki before it signs.
apps.name: Bitcoin

permissions.name: link
permissions.reason: So maki desktop and your wallet software can ask for your account, addresses and signatures.

permissions.name: camera
permissions.reason: To read transactions off your wallet software's screen, to sign with no cable.

permissions.name: wallet
permissions.reason: To sign the transactions you approve on maki's screen, and nothing else.

apps.description: Knock out the bricks with the ball, a paddle below that follows as you tilt maki (or left and right move it). Three balls a game, faster with each wall you clear. Keeps your best score.
apps.name: Breakout

permissions.name: motion
permissions.reason: To move the paddle as you tilt maki.

apps.description: A game clock for two, for chess, Go and Scrabble: each player presses their side's button, with increments, delays, stages and byo-yomi, and each time turned to face its player across the table.
apps.name: Chess Clock

apps.description: Your card as a QR code, signed by your maki, to swap at the con: scan theirs, and maki checks it's signed and keeps who you met and when. maki desktop sets your card, and saves the people you met as vCards.
apps.name: Contacts

permissions.name: ask
permissions.reason: To ask you before your card changes, and before the computer sees who you met.

permissions.name: link
permissions.reason: So maki desktop can set your card, and save the people you met.

permissions.name: keys
permissions.reason: For your card's key, from your recovery phrase: it signs your card.

permissions.name: camera
permissions.reason: To read people's cards (a maki's, or a phone's contact QR code).

apps.description: Dice for tabletop games, as players say them: 3d6, 1d20. The jog dial on maki's side picks the die (d2 to d20), left and right how many, and the centre rolls.
apps.name: Dice

apps.description: Ask a question, shake maki, and the answer floats up: one of the classic twenty, picked by maki's random number generator. No accelerometer? Press a button.
apps.name: Magic 8-Ball

permissions.name: motion
permissions.reason: To know when you shake maki.

apps.description: Your Ethereum account, from maki's recovery phrase, as MetaMask and Ledger make it: for sites through the maki extension, maki desktop's wallet, and MetaMask by QR codes. Every transaction, message and permit is shown on maki before it signs.
apps.name: Ethereum

permissions.name: link
permissions.reason: So sites (through the maki extension) and maki desktop can ask for your account and signatures.

permissions.name: camera
permissions.reason: To read what MetaMask asks it to sign off its screen, with no cable.

permissions.name: wallet
permissions.reason: To sign the transactions and messages you approve on maki's screen, and nothing else.

apps.description: Initiative and hit points for a tabletop fight, beside Dice: who's up, round by round, with the centre passing the turn, and the jog dial on maki's side taking damage off whoever's picked or healing them. Keeps the table.
apps.name: Initiative

apps.description: maki's accelerometer as instruments: a g-meter for the car, the bike or a ride, with its peaks; a horizon and slip ball, as a pilot's; and a spirit level, to a tenth of a degree once calibrated.
apps.name: Instruments

permissions.name: motion
permissions.reason: To read how maki is tilted and pushed: the g-meter, the horizon and the level.

apps.description: A life counter for Magic and other games, 2 to 6 players: the jog dial on maki's side counts life, the player across the table reads theirs the right way up, and poison and commander damage are kept too.
apps.name: Life

apps.description: Roll a marble through a maze by tilting maki, into the hole at the far corner. Every maze is new; keeps how many you've solved and your fastest.
apps.name: Marble

permissions.name: motion
permissions.reason: To roll the marble as you tilt maki.

apps.description: A minisign key from your recovery phrase, for signing files and releases through maki desktop's maki-minisign. Each file waits for your yes on maki, which signs when it did by its own clock. Anyone checks them with minisign.
apps.name: Minisign

permissions.name: ask
permissions.reason: To ask you before it signs each file.

permissions.name: link
permissions.reason: To answer maki desktop's maki-minisign, which asks it to sign files.

permissions.name: keys
permissions.reason: For your minisign key, made from your recovery phrase and never leaving maki.

apps.description: Your Monero wallet, from maki's recovery phrase, as a Ledger makes it: addresses as QR codes, the 25 backup words, which maki shows you itself, and sending from maki desktop or the Monero GUI: you check each payment and the fee here, and maki signs.
apps.name: Monero

permissions.name: link
permissions.reason: So maki desktop can ask for addresses, watch the wallet if you let it, and send what you say yes to.

permissions.name: wallet
permissions.reason: Your addresses, your backup words shown by maki, the view key when you say, and signing on a yes.

apps.description: Morse code on the jog dial, a paddle: up a dot, down a dash. Key it (and type it into the computer, if you like), learn it from the screen flashing like a signal lamp, or flash a message across a room.
apps.name: Morse

permissions.name: keyboard
permissions.reason: To type what you key into the computer, once you turn typing on.

apps.description: Your Nostr key, from maki's recovery phrase. Sites use it through the maki extension (NIP-07): maki asks before a site sees it, and shows each note before it signs. Open it for your npub as a QR code.
apps.name: Nostr

permissions.name: ask
permissions.reason: To ask you before a site sees your key, and before each thing it signs.

permissions.name: link
permissions.reason: So sites can ask for your key and signatures through the maki extension and maki desktop.

permissions.name: keys
permissions.reason: For your Nostr key: maki's, from your recovery phrase, the same on a restored maki.

apps.description: Secrets you read on maki, never on the computer again: recovery codes, PINs, a safe's combination. Send one from maki desktop, which forgets it, or scan it; Type it types one into a field when you pick it.
apps.name: Notes

permissions.name: ask
permissions.reason: To ask you before it keeps a note your computer sends.

permissions.name: link
permissions.reason: So maki desktop can send it notes, and see their titles (never what they say).

permissions.name: keyboard
permissions.reason: To type a note into your computer when you pick Type it.

permissions.name: camera
permissions.reason: To read a note from a QR code when you pick Scan a note.

apps.description: Your OpenPGP key from your recovery phrase, for gpg and git through maki desktop's maki-gpg: each commit shows its subject on maki before it's signed, and each message sent to you is opened only once you say so here.
apps.name: OpenPGP

permissions.name: ask
permissions.reason: To ask you before it signs anything, names your key, or opens a message.

permissions.name: link
permissions.reason: To answer maki desktop's maki-gpg, which gpg and git run.

permissions.name: keys
permissions.reason: For your OpenPGP keys, made from your recovery phrase and never leaving maki.

apps.description: Passphrases from maki's random number generator: four to eight words from the EFF's long word list, about 13 bits each. Never stored; typed into your computer only if you ask.
apps.name: Passphrase

permissions.name: keyboard
permissions.reason: To type the passphrase into your computer when you pick Type it, so you needn't copy it by hand.

apps.description: A focus timer, like a clock: a pie empties as you work, the screen flashes, and it fills back up while you rest.
apps.name: Pomodoro

apps.description: A slide clicker: the jog dial on maki's side goes to the next slide or back, the centre blanks the screen, and a timer you can read from the stage counts down your talk, flashing as the end nears.
apps.name: Presenter

permissions.name: keyboard
permissions.reason: To change your slides: Page Down, Page Up, B to blank the screen, F5 and Esc to start and end.

apps.description: Reads a QR code and shows what it says, a page at a time. Type it types the text into your computer, and says first if that would press Enter or Tab. Nothing it reads is kept.
apps.name: Scanner

permissions.name: keyboard
permissions.reason: To type what a code says into your computer when you pick Type it.

permissions.name: camera
permissions.reason: To read QR codes when you press the centre.

apps.description: A spirit level from the accelerometer, and a QR code reader: the centre scans, and shows what the code says.
apps.name: Sensors

permissions.name: camera
permissions.reason: To read QR codes when you press the centre.

permissions.name: motion
permissions.reason: For the spirit level.

apps.description: The snake game, steered the way it's to go: the jog dial on maki's side for up and down, the buttons for left and right. Eat to grow; walls and your own tail end it. Keeps your best score.
apps.name: Snake

apps.description: Your Solana account, from maki's recovery phrase, as Phantom and Solflare make it: for sites through the maki extension, and maki desktop's wallet. Every transfer, token and fee is shown on maki before it signs.
apps.name: Solana

permissions.name: link
permissions.reason: So sites (through the maki extension) and maki desktop can ask for your account and signatures.

permissions.name: wallet
permissions.reason: To sign the transactions and messages you approve on maki's screen, and nothing else.

apps.description: An SSH key from your recovery phrase, for ssh and git through maki desktop's SSH agent, and a certificate authority's if you turn it on. Every sign-in, certificate and signature waits for your yes on maki, a commit's with its subject and author.
apps.name: SSH

permissions.name: ask
permissions.reason: To ask you before every sign-in and signature.

permissions.name: link
permissions.reason: To answer maki desktop's SSH agent, which ssh and git talk to.

permissions.name: keys
permissions.reason: For your SSH key, made from your recovery phrase and never leaving maki.

apps.description: A sign on maki's screen, big enough to read across the room: Available, Busy, On a call and the like. Software on your computer can set it too.
apps.name: Status

permissions.name: link
permissions.reason: So software on your computer can set the status (when a call starts, say) or ask what it is.

apps.description: Every command sudo runs waits for your yes on maki, which shows it whole: the command line, what it's given to run with, and who asked where. maki desktop's sudo plugin asks once sudoers says yes, and checks maki's signature: nothing on your computer can say yes for you, even with your password.
apps.name: Sudo

permissions.name: ask
permissions.reason: To show you each command sudo would run, and ask you.

permissions.name: link
permissions.reason: To hear from maki desktop's sudo plugin, which asks it about each command.

permissions.name: keys
permissions.reason: For the key your computer's sudo checks your yes with, from your recovery phrase.

apps.description: Counts things: the centre adds one, left takes one away, and the jog dial on maki's side counts up or down. Remembers the count.
apps.name: Tally

apps.description: Leave maki on your closed laptop: armed, its screen goes dark and it logs every time it's moved, and every press. Your code, pressed on the dark screen, shows you what happened while you were away.
apps.name: Tamper Log

permissions.name: motion
permissions.reason: To notice maki being moved while it's armed.

apps.description: Your Wi-Fi networks as QR codes: guests scan maki's screen to join. Add a network by scanning its QR code (a router's sticker, a phone's share screen) or send it from your computer.
apps.name: Wi-Fi

permissions.name: link
permissions.reason: So your computer can send it networks to show, or ask which it has.

permissions.name: camera
permissions.reason: To read a network's QR code, from a router's sticker or a phone's share screen.
